}

export interface AppearanceEvent { kind: 'snapshot'; rev: number; data: AppearanceDto; resync?: boolean; }

export interface CreateSessionRequest {

export interface ProjectDto {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  root: string;
  repositoryRoots: (string)[];
  folderId?: string | null;
  notifyOnAgentDone: boolean;
  wakeOrchestratorsOnAgentDone: boolean;
  codexAccount: ProjectCodexAccountDto;
  /** The engine retains unreadable future choices verbatim. Their unknown JSON keys are data, not bridge fields. */
  orchestrator: unknown;
  /** Known policy fields are camelCase; unreadable future keys and values remain verbatim, including a policy that was not an object. */
  delegationPolicy: unknown;
  createdAt: number;
}

export interface ProjectInspectionDto {
  root: string;

export interface ProjectMemoDto {
  text: string;
  updatedAt: number;
}

export type SearchHitDto = { kind: 'project'; item: ProjectDto } | { kind: 'worktree'; item: WorktreeDto } | { kind: 'task'; item: TaskDto };

export interface SessionsEvent { kind: 'snapshot'; rev: number; data: SessionsSnapshot; resync?: boolean; }

/** Both explicit reads and process samples use this shape. Activity timestamps are intentionally not exposed in phase 1a: the engine sample has no activity map, and mixing an absent map with `list_with_activity` would create spurious differences in the subscription stream. */
export interface SessionsSnapshot {
  sessions: (ShellSessionDto)[];
}

export interface SettingsEvent { kind: 'snapshot'; rev: number; data: SettingsDto; resync?: boolean; }

export interface SettingsPatch { theme?: string; useRiworkColors?: boolean; nativeTerminalColors?: boolean; uiTextSize?: number; uiTextMatchesTerminal?: boolean; interfaceFont?: 'system' | 'system_mono'; statusBar?: StatusBarDto; }

export interface AppearanceModule {
  get(): Promise<AppearanceDto>;
  /** Resolve for the caller's current host appearance. A per-window host event never overwrites another window's effective appearance. */
  resolve(theme: string, systemDark: boolean): Promise<AppearanceDto>;
  subscribe(listener: (value: AppearanceEvent) => void): Subscription;
}

export declare const Appearance: AppearanceModule;

export declare const Dashboard: DashboardModule;

/** Layout IO runs in Rust's blocking pool. JS never receives a filesystem path. */
export interface LayoutsModule {
  /** Open the project in the process's fixed home, honoring a reload snapshot. */
  openSession(request: unknown): Promise<LayoutSession>;
}

/** Layout IO runs in Rust's blocking pool. JS never receives a filesystem path. */
export declare const Layouts: LayoutsModule;

/** Persistent shell inventory; attaching terminal views belongs to the host. */

  subscribe(listener: (value: SessionsEvent) => void): Subscription;
}

/** Persistent shell inventory; attaching terminal views belongs to the host. */
export declare const Sessions: SessionsModule;

/** Durable project, folder, worktree and task reads. */
export interface StoreModule {
  createFolder(name: string, parentId?: string | null): Promise<FolderDto>;
  renameFolder(id: string, name: string): Promise<FolderDto>;
  moveFolder(id: string, parentId?: string | null): Promise<FolderDto>;
  removeFolder(id: string): Promise<void>;
  moveProjectToFolder(projectId: string, folderId?: string | null): Promise<ProjectDto>;
  snapshot(): Promise<StoreState>;
  search(query: string): Promise<(SearchHitDto)[]>;
  inspectProject(root: string): Promise<ProjectInspectionDto>;
  /** First delivers a snapshot, then pushes changed snapshots until closed or the rendering owner goes. The injected context is invisible in TypeScript. */
  subscribe(listener: (value: StoreEvent) => void): Subscription;
}

/** Durable project, folder, worktree and task reads. */
export declare const Store: StoreModule;

export interface TabsModule {

/** Window-owned in-memory authority; DockArea receives only its projections. */
export declare class LayoutSession {
  /** Made by the class's members only. */
  private constructor();
  /** Generate a controlled DockAreaLayout from the authoritative core layout. */
  dock(size: unknown): unknown;
  /** Replay one DockArea gesture using core rules, then return its projection. */
  applyDock(next: unknown, size: unknown): unknown;
  /** Preserve locked pixel extents through the core's window-resize algorithm. */
  setExtent(size: unknown): unknown;
  /** Select a stable panel identity and its owning pane. */
  selectPanel(panelId: string): unknown;
  openPanel(panel: string): unknown;
  defaultLayout(): unknown;
  /** Activate a pane without changing its selected tab (including empty panes). */
  selectPane(paneId: number): unknown;
  /** Toggle the explicit lock set, preserving the difference from automatic locks. */
  toggleLock(paneId: number): unknown;
  /** Select or clear the project's unique main pane. */
  toggleMain(paneId: number): unknown;
  /** Gather unlocked sources into main without closing any session. */
  gather(): unknown;
  /** Tab/pane presentation metadata. Persistence uses the separate core snapshot. */
  snapshot(): unknown;
  /** Frozen panel lookup; empty sentinels have no persisted SavedTab. */
  panel(panelId: string): unknown;
  /** Await persistence off the engine thread; the host has its own Rust barrier. */
  flush(): Promise<void>;
  /** Frees the Rust value now (else when the object is collected); the object throws after. */
  dispose(): void;
  [Symbol.dispose](): void;
}

/** A live subscription. Closing, disposal, collection and owner teardown end its engine task, dropping and closing the bounded topic queue. */
export declare class Subscription {
  /** Made by the class's members only. */
  private constructor();
  close(): void;
  /** Frees the Rust value now (else when the object is collected); the object throws after. */
  dispose(): void;
  [Symbol.dispose](): void;
}
